name: io.github.gistrec/mcp-yandex-kit
title: A1 Yandex KIT MCP
description: A1 Yandex KIT MCP server for the Yandex KIT e-commerce API: products, orders, discounts, webhooks and more.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_KIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Yandex KIT API token from the merchant cabinet (Настройки → API → Сгенерировать токен; shown once). Full store access — treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_KIT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Yandex KIT API.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_KIT_RPS
environmentVariables.description: Client-side rate limit in requests per second (the API allows 3 rps per store).
